verdict.rationale: Ironclad's docs show contracts created in a no-code builder and run through published, Workflow Designer-controlled workflows that enforce approval and signature policies. Integrations can push new document versions, which covers the drafting and controlled-workflow core of the story. The evidence pack never explicitly describes negotiation or in-platform redlining, so the 'negotiate and redline' half is only implied; missing for 10: explicit documentation of redlining/tracked-changes and counterparty negotiation, independent hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
